mechanism: Use a neutral two-shot to establish equal conversational footing, show one visible speaking turn, hold a clearly readable pause, show a second speaking turn, and end on the first speaker's silent reaction. The source supports only this visual turn-taking and reaction grammar; any question, answer meaning or comic mismatch is an explicitly original instantiation slot, never a source-derived fact.

invariants.rule: Begin with a neutral two-shot and stable eye lines.
invariants.purpose: Makes later singles spatially and socially legible.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on isolated faces hides the relationship.

invariants.rule: Use one compact first speaking turn, with its meaning supplied only by the new original instance.
invariants.purpose: Creates a clean expectation without inventing source semantics.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple setup turns blur ownership and weaken the pause.

invariants.rule: Hold one clearly readable pause between the two visible speaking turns.
invariants.purpose: Builds a timing interval without inventing source semantics.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate second turn removes the visible timing contrast.

invariants.rule: Use one compact second speaking turn with minimal gesture; its meaning is an original instance variable.
invariants.purpose: Preserves the visible turn-taking structure while allowing new content.
invariants.ablation_failure: A large performance or extra line turns the held exchange into a sketch montage.

invariants.rule: End on the first character's silent reaction with no additional speaking turn.
invariants.purpose: Lets the final visible reaction complete the timing pattern.
invariants.ablation_failure: Additional speaking turns weaken the final hold.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
